title: apg 0.9.3 — fix note-add orphan bug + Details-edge binder error
goal: Fix the `apg spec add note` write-through bug that leaves orphan Note nodes when the re-ingest fails, add `--on` target validation, investigate + fix the LadybugDB binder error on certain Details edges, and ship it as a 0.9.3 release.

title: Atomic write-through — no orphan nodes on re-ingest failure
body: Make write_jsonl_and_reingest atomic so a re-ingest failure never leaves the JSONL committed with orphan Note nodes in the live DB. `add_note` pushes a Note + Details record, then write_through writes the JSONL FIRST and re-ingests afterwards; if the re-ingest's merge_edge throws a LadybugDB binder error on a Details edge, the JSONL is already committed and the DB is left with orphan Notes (5 such orphans were found and removed). Fix: write the JSONL to a temp file and rename into place only after a successful re-ingest, or roll the JSONL back to its prior content on re-ingest failure, so a failed mutation never leaves orphans.

title: add_note rejects non-Details --on targets before any write
body: In add_note, reject --on targets whose node label is not an allowable Details target (Note/Feedback excluded) with a clear CLI message, before writing any JSONL or re-ingesting. Today --on accepts targets like cosanima-rename/note-2 (a Note); the DB's Details rel-table only allows target labels {Module, AcceptanceCriterion, Spec, Function, Struct, VerificationItem, Requirement, PlanPhase, Plan, Decision, File, Task, NonGoal, Phase}, so the invalid target fails at the DB layer with a confusing binder error instead of a clear CLI validation.

title: Controlled reproduction + root cause of the rename-spec/D1 Details-edge binder error
body: Produce a controlled reproduction of the LadybugDB binder error thrown on certain Details edges: adding a note targeting cosanima-rename/spec (Spec) and cosanima-rename/spec.decision-D1 (Decision) throws the binder error, while IDENTICAL label targets in other projects (cosanima-mcp spec, cosanima-1.0 decision-D5) succeed. Labels were confirmed identical via `MATCH (n) WHERE n.fqn IN [...] RETURN labels(n)`. Determine the actual trigger (possible LadybugDB rel-table/schema bug vs app-side) and record the root cause.

title: Fix so a note attaches to ANY allowable Details target in any project
body: After the root cause in R3 is established, fix it so `apg spec add note --on <Spec|Decision|...>` works for any allowable Details target (Spec, Decision, Requirement, Phase, etc.) in any project, without a binder error. The fix lands at the app layer (merge_edge/merge_records) if the root cause is app-side, or as a LadybugDB schema/rel-table adjustment + regression test if it is a genuine DB schema bug.

title: 0.9.3 version bump + release records
body: Bump the crate version to 0.9.3 (Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock, currently 0.9.2) and update the release records per the 0.9.1→0.9.2 release pattern: Formula/*.rb tag v0.9.3 + revision pointer + rebuild + bottle sha256 (the six Formula files currently point at v0.9.2), and README version strings. Note: the repo carries no committed CHANGELOG.md (verified at authoring time), so the release note lives in the repo's actual release records (README, Formula, SPEC docs / git tag) rather than a nonexistent CHANGELOG.

title: Full cargo test green + tag v0.9.3
body: Run the full `cargo test` suite and confirm it is green, then tag v0.9.3 matching the 0.9.1→0.9.2 tag pattern (version-bump commit + annotated tag + Formula revision pointers + bottle sha256s).

summary: Atomic write-through: temp-file + atomic rename into place only after a successful re-ingest
Validation scope: reject the three excluded labels (Note/Feedback) at the CLI in add_note; leave the DB Details schema untouched
Binder root cause resolved by the controlled reproduction; fix lands at whichever layer the reproduction indicts

body: No 1.0 work: no rename to cosanima, no MCP, no repo split, no frontend contract, no license change — all of that stays in the 1.0 spec family (cosanima-1.0, cosanima-rename, cosanima-mcp, cosanima-repo-split, cosanima-frontend-interface, cosanima-frontend-ci, cosanima-license, cosanima-docs). This 0.9.3 spec targets the current apg codebase only.
No behaviour change beyond the bug fix + release. No new features, no rework of the note-authoring UX beyond the --on validation, no schema changes beyond whatever the binder investigation requires.
Not a child of cosanima-1.0. This is a standalone pre-1.0 maintenance release, not part of the 1.0 flag-day family.

Reproduce the orphan scenario (a note add whose re-ingest fails, e.g. via the old Details binder path) and assert that after the fix zero orphan Note nodes remain in the live DB and the JSONL is consistent — either the mutation was not committed, or the JSONL was rolled back to its prior content.
`apg spec add note --on <project>/note-<n>` (a Note target) and a Feedback target are rejected with a clear CLI message before any write — the JSONL is unchanged and the live DB is untouched.

`apg spec add note --on cosanima-rename/spec` and `--on cosanima-rename/spec.decision-D1` succeed without a binder error, and an identical note attaches to Spec/Decision nodes in any project (cosanima-mcp spec, cosanima-1.0 decision-D5) — the binder mystery is resolved and any allowable Details target works everywhere.

Cargo.toml (and Cargo.lock) report version 0.9.3; the six Formula/*.rb files point at tag v0.9.3 with updated revision/rebuild/sha256 per the 0.9.1→0.9.2 pattern; the full `cargo test` suite is green; tag v0.9.3 exists on the release branch.

Controlled orphan-reproduction test: force a re-ingest failure during a note add and assert zero orphan Note nodes remain in the DB afterwards (query the graph for Note nodes with no incident Details edge).
CLI test: `apg spec add note --on cosanima-rename/spec` and `--on cosanima-rename/spec.decision-D1` succeed; assert no binder error and the note lands in the JSONL and the live DB.

CLI test: `apg spec add note --on <project>/note-<n>` (Note target) and `--on <project>/<future>` (planned-node target) exit non-zero with a clear message; assert the JSONL and the live DB are unchanged.
Full `cargo test` runs green in the repo.
Version/tag artifacts present: Cargo.toml version = "0.9.3", Formula/*.rb reference tag v0.9.3 with revision + bottle sha256, and git tag v0.9.3 exists.

The orphan bug: `apg spec add note --on <target>` pushes a Note + Details record, then write_through → artifacts::write_jsonl_and_reingest (artifacts.rs:52-68) writes the JSONL FIRST, then reingest_project (artifacts.rs:549-575) detaches the project and re-merges ALL spec/plan/note records via ArtifactDb::merge_records (307-324). If the re-ingest's merge_edge (279-305) throws a LadybugDB binder error on a Details edge, the JSONL is already committed and the live DB is left with orphan Note nodes — verified: 5 such orphans were found and removed.

The mystery: adding a note targeting cosanima-rename/spec (Spec) and cosanima-rename/spec.decision-D1 (Decision) threw the binder error, while IDENTICAL label targets in other projects (cosanima-mcp spec, cosanima-1.0 decision-D5) succeeded. Labels were confirmed identical via `MATCH (n) WHERE n.fqn IN [...] RETURN labels(n)`. This needs a controlled reproduction to find the actual trigger — a possible LadybugDB rel-table/schema bug — before the fix.

Design: the atomic write-through fix writes the JSONL to a sibling temp file, runs the re-ingest against the live DB, and only renames the temp file over the committed JSONL after the re-ingest succeeds (D1). This gives a single commit point for the durable JSONL and the live DB and avoids snapshotting prior file contents.

Design: the --on validation's allowable label set mirrors the DB Details rel-table pairs — src/load.rs spec_rel_pairs() declares `FROM Note TO {Module, Function, Struct, File, Spec, Requirement, Phase, Decision, NonGoal, AcceptanceCriterion, VerificationItem, Plan, PlanPhase, Task}` — so Note/Feedback are excluded as Details targets and rejected at the CLI in add_note (D2), before any write.

Relationship to the 1.0 spec family: this is a pre-1.0 maintenance fix (0.9.3, on the current `apg` codebase) that unblocks the 1.0 spec-authoring loop, which hit the note-add orphan bug and the Details-edge binder error while attaching notes to cosanima-rename/1.0 nodes. It is STANDALONE — deliberately not a child of cosanima-1.0 and not part of the 1.0 flag-day family (cosanima-1.0, cosanima-rename, cosanima-mcp, cosanima-repo-split, cosanima-frontend-interface, cosanima-frontend-ci, cosanima-license, cosanima-docs). No 1.0 work happens here.

Post-completion state (phase 3 completed, plan apg-0.9.3 retired): R5 (and R6) are orphan requirements — no Satisfies (plan JSONL dropped) and no Implements edges. Root cause: plan_cmd.rs plan_complete materializes Implements only from the phase's done-task anchors (built_codes, plan_cmd.rs:512-532); all five phase-03 tasks carry no Anchors (version bump touches Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/Formula/*.rb/README.md — none are graph nodes), so the `if !built.is_empty() && !satisfied.is_empty()` branch was skipped. Consequence: apg_spec_unresolved reports R5/R6 as orphans and the spec can never show fully implemented. The release work itself is verified done (Cargo.toml 0.9.3; Cargo.lock apg 0.9.3; all 7 Formula/*.rb tag v0.9.3 + revision da846be13a756695f7dd9dfe3f935fa8cd5c5cc5 + root_url v0.9.3, no v0.9.2 refs; README 0.9.3; release-gate test src/main.rs:1216-1281; --version via env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION") main.rs:545). Decision needed: accept the git-tag/release-record as the durable artifact for R5/R6 (spec stays planned), or re-anchor release tasks to a code node (e.g. src/main.rs) in a follow-up plan so Implements edges materialize on completion.
